evidence.quoted_text: exec(compile(data, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)  # noqa: S102 - bound bytes
evidence.reason: The helper-load boundary already translates unreadable bytes and digest mismatches into Refused, but line 82 lets a compile-time SyntaxError escape. On the --json path that bypasses the existing clean-error handling and produces an empty stdout with a traceback on stderr, contrary to the current I1 machine-mode requirement that stderr stay empty and errors be written as an { error: … } object on stdout. Catching the compile failure here and raising Refused is the smallest compatible repair while preserving the hash-before-execute behavior.
